stopping.comparison: running best at current boundary minus running best eight eval boundaries earlier < 0.001
stopping.amendment2: trailing train-loss improvement = (mean loss over the first 250 updates of the 2,000-step window minus mean loss over the final 250 updates) / first-window mean; plateau iff that ratio < 1% AND best-val gain < 0.001 (0.1pp) at step >= 10,000

selection: max validation full-state exact accuracy; lower CE then earlier update. Persist frozen checkpoint identity and SHA256 before any extrapolation test evaluation.
checkpoint_policy: If free capacity <400GiB at a checkpoint check, retain best-val chain, every10K grid, latest250 rolling, own stop, legacy fixed {1000,4000,8000,12000,16000,18269}, and all known headline stop steps; scan published frozen selections each prune. Each prune records removed steps and retained hashes. Any cross-arm panel cell whose checkpoint was already pruned before its step became required is reported as unavailable/pruned - never imputed, never re-created by interpolation, never silently dropped. Stop steps broadcast via selection_frozen.json; running arms scan each250 check.
interpretation: Arithmetic control failure blocks depth-specific interpretation, not publication. No impossibility, universal expressivity, or CMA-causal claim.
resource_policy: local lambda01 GPUs only; scripts/gpu_lease.sh exclusive lease per arm; no WorksGood service or scheduler
reporting: all per-seed results and counts, paired contrasts, sample SD/SEM for three-seed headline arms; one-seed mechanism exploratory
padding_amendment: Supervisor approved identical constant-zero right padding to multiple16 for every architecture and split; slice logits before loss/scoring. Real prefixes causally unchanged, no target leakage. CPU tests verify real logits/loss equality and zero padded-logit gradient.
